2014_spells.witch-bolt.description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lurches toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 lightning damage, and on each of your turns for the duration, you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning damage to it automatically.
2014_spells.witch-bolt.effectSummary: Deal 1d12 lightning damage to a target within 30 ft
2014_spells.witch-bolt.fullDescription: Using 1 action, on a hit, the target takes 1d12 lightning damage, and on each of your turns for the duration, you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning damage to it automatically. Make a ranged spell attack against it; A beam of crackling, blue energy lurches toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 1st. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 minute.
